crossRefs.note: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my…
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

translations.web: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
translations.bsb: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
translations.kjv: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
translations.asv: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;
